identity.title: Acupoint Stimulation for Enhanced Recovery After Colon Surgery: A Prospective Multicenter Randomized Controlled Trial
identity.registration: NCT02921529; first posted2016-10-03 before November2016 start; current record updated June2018

denominator_evidence: Figure1 visually checked: TEAS3 open conversions; sham2 open conversions+1 rejected intervention. Supplement8 confirms center totals50/47 per arm.
intervention: Surface TEAS 2/10Hz 4–11mA30min preinduction and mornings POD1–3; sham electrode/no current; article says PC6/ST36 but supplement1 includes LI4/PC6/ST36/SP6.

results.source_location: Table3 pp5–6 visually checked; values TEAS vs sham
results.discharge_format_conflict: Narrative median±; table mean±SD footnote. Confirm with authors if synthesized.
results.PONV_window: Registry cumulative end-surgery→24/48/72; decreasing later counts incompatible with cumulative event counts, so later interval definition unresolved.
results.PCA_24_typo: TEAS delivery median printed5.0.0; preserve source typo, interpreted5.0 provisional.
results.QoR15_conflict: Table24 TEAS worse P=.01, narrative values TEAS numerically better but calls lower P=.04. Do not resolve by picking agreement. High priority author query.

analgesia.evidence: Supplement2 only standard PCA + preincision ropivacaine infiltration; no drug concentration. Button counts cannot become mg.

source_review: Entire9-page article read; pp4–6 visually checked; official supplement downloaded and text read; official registry API checked before baseline.

rob_independent.D1: Some concerns: computer sequence; sealed envelopes not established opaque; only analyzed cohort baseline reported. 1.1Y1.2NI1.3NI.
rob_independent.D2: Some concerns: patients/interventionist unmasked; standardized ERAS no clear trial-context cointervention, but6 postrandomization eligible exclusions; mITT conditional on receipt not appropriate ITT, substantial impact uncertain.
rob_independent.D3: Some concerns for GI/pain/QoR:94/100, conversions prognostic for recovery; no sensitivity; could depend on true outcome but actual differential missingness not demonstrated.
rob_independent.D4: Some concerns for pain, QoR, nausea, self-reported flatus; observer masked but participant aware. Defecation more observable but timing relies reporting; no strong evidence probable influence.
rob_independent.D5: Some concerns: registry prospective but original detailed SAP unavailable; QoR conflicting numbers not proof results-based selection, numerically unresolved.

opioid_decision: Excluded: attempts/deliveries proxy, no postoperative dose.
independence: Distinct colon RCT from Lu2021 mastectomy, same investigator not same cohort.
